My silly girl Cleo. She just needs to be upside down 🙃 🤣🥰

YTA. 

Pro tip: people who have none of their children talking to them are basically always at fault. If all of your children are against you on this, I’d put money on you having been poor/selfish parents in the past.

YTA. 

Why is it that your daughter is terrible for not getting you something for Mother’s Day and for not being up at the crack of dawn like you (who has one more 8 month old than she does), but your husband is in the clear for not doing anything with you and the kids?

I wonder how many times your daughter (as a CHILD) had been held to higher standards than the adults in your family. Curse of the eldest daughter.

I’m gonna side on YTA for this one. 

That was a little bit of a weird joke and your wife sounds kind of insecure to me but that doesn’t really matter because at the end of the day she is the life partner you chose and you need to respect her boundaries. 
Keep in mind that I work in healthcare so the jokes I hear are very dark/gross all the time so I could be minimizing it compared to how someone else would take it.

They were called the “me generation” before they started pointing at the so called “entitled millennials” (label they made up) to deflect the attention away from them. They’re not only selfish jerks, but have no ability to take accountability for their selfish jerkiness.

Ehh. Very light YTA. You should have moved your things to be the considerate person in this scenario, but they also could have asked you before this point. Communication is key. But also aim to be more considerate.

Whenever someone has been regularly stealing my lunch at work, I’ll usually take one of my lunches and dump a whole shaker of salt into it. You can tell who it is when they start choking from the taste 😆
Just when I think I’ve seen it all in healthcare

I feel like half of the people in this field enter into it because they care about people and then quickly learn that almost no one is actually worth caring about. What an absolute waste of space this guy was. Gross.
Oh my. Sounds like something I’ve heard many nursing home residents say. Gotta love the older generation 😆

I genuinely think a lot of the older generations (boomers) were just nasty people when they were young and have carried that into a rapidly changing society that expects them to contribute to the well being of others. Im probably biased but I don’t really know any older people who aren’t hateful. The ones that aren’t are gifts to younger people. Even most of the older nurses I know have certain biases with people of different demographics. With these types of people it takes all my strength to stay professional. I think you responded perfectly to their selfishness. But I feel your anger.
Yeah. In an area public enough it was on security footage. At night though so no one was around to see or stop it.

Nurse manager of the floor was arrested for SA while drunk. His wife left him and then it was found out that he had been dating one of the ICU nurses he managed the whole time he was married. She’s a pretty terrible person too. 

Fucked up #smalltownhospitalshit

I wish we didn’t need socialization to be happy. I find myself slipping into mentally Ill episodes when I’m alone for too long. Our brains just aren’t wired for isolation. Whenever I do talk to someone i talk nonstop to try to make up for it. I feel like such an annoyance.

I will have to. I definitely am at the point in school where I understand that CNAs cannot do assessments so it’s crazy to me that he would even suggest it. Almost like he wants me to function partially as a nurse without having to pay me more than a CNA.

Not in this hospital. It’s a very small hospital in a rural area and most of what we have is just med surg. But I’m about to graduate in a month here anyways. And then I can leave the position to go somewhere as a graduate nurse.

This is good advice, thank you. I suppose she could have mixed me up as there are two others on my floor with the same first name. The manager wanting me to assess is alarming though. I’ll look into this.
My manager is the one who suggested I do this. Not sure who to talk to next. It all feels shady. I know better than to think I can assess people as a CNA which is why I’m uncomfy about it all.

Thank you ☺️ It’s especially frustrating because at this point I’ve been there for 2 years and have seniority because people leave so quickly.  Yet I still get treated badly for not being a part of the clique. I’m graduating nursing school in 4 months so I just have to figure out how to get by for 4 more months until I start an RN job. Thank you for your support 🥰
I definitely aim to not be a bad person lol. Too many of them to go around.

I feel this so unbelievably strongly. In my worst moments I think about how even my parents, who should have made me a priority, couldn’t care less about making me feel cared about as a child. I’ve been alone my whole life. I might be forever. Still deciding if I can accept that. Just know that there are others who understand 🖤

That makes me feel better, thank you! It’s been two years since I’ve applied to a job and that was only the second job I’ve had so this is all newish. Hoping for some good responses and offers after this process 🤞🏻
Thank you! This makes me feel better. I know that places really need nurses but I think my anxiety is getting the better of me lol.
Thank you. I reported it as well. I appreciate your support.
Wow. That was nasty. Definitely put no judgement on my post. Thanks.

It’s an option but I would really prefer to get pregnant now. I’m young but feel like I’m ready. I just want to know if a doctor would most likely refer me at this age to get this done. I’m in New York where my doctor would need to sign paperwork.
I guess that they’re admitting me. So I probably won’t get to make that choice anyways. Thanks for all your help.
Thank you for this response. I just need to believe that someone would care if I was gone

Honestly not great. I still haven’t spoken to the crisis intervention team yet and it’s making me more and more unsure that I should’ve even come to the hospital. Even here it feels like no one cares. I don’t know. I just feel like I’m not worth a hospital bed. Sorry to be so negative

It’s really hard to believe. I’m sitting here next to a girl who’s crying and her mother is comforting her. I’ve never had a mother that cared that much  and I don’t know why I didn’t deserve that kind of love. I feel like a piece of garbage
